# POSpire v1.0.6: Payment Methods Fix

Fixes a defect that stopped newly created POS Profiles from taking payment at all.

## Payment methods missing on normal sales

On a POS Profile with **Use Cashback** turned off, the Payment Methods section did not render and Paid Amount stayed at 0.00 while To Be Paid showed the invoice total. Paid Amount is a read-only running total, so with the payment rows gone there was nothing on screen to enter an amount into and the sale could not be completed.

Use Cashback ships disabled by default, so this affected every POS Profile created fresh. It was not an unusual configuration.

The cause was one flag doing two unrelated jobs. Besides controlling refunds on returns, the cashback state also decided whether the payment rows rendered, whether Paid Amount was calculated, and whether the change calculation was validated. Cashback now governs returns only, and normal sales always take payment.

Reported in #58 by @johnwslongland, whose screenshot made this straightforward to trace.

### If you cannot upgrade yet

Open the POS Profile, tick **Use Cashback**, save, and reload POSpire. The payment rows come back and sales complete normally.

Be aware this also enables cashback handling on returns. Before submitting a return, check the **Cashback?** toggle and turn it off unless you intend an immediate cash refund rather than store credit.
